issues.title: UI should reflect `health`
issues.body:
We have two concepts of health in an asset:
* health field (integer, running from zero (dead) to 100 (alive) )
* condition: if this takes the value of the last field in the `conditions` for the `plaform-type` - then it's dead

We should indicate the alive status of each asset in the `assets` tables and on the map.  I'm pretty sure we have styling for this, just extend it to support `health`, and check it works for our icons.

**Update** - have _tried_ to do health checking, and have give some assets a zero health value in the story for `PlanningChannel`.    We just have to handle the rendering.

The new data/health-checking is in this PR: https://github.com/serge-web/serge/pull/2095
